label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
Rohan, fair question da. You and Divya trusted me with real money, so you both deserve a straight answer. And Sneha, no need to protect me from this one 😅

Yes, we let 6 of our 14 people go last Friday. The bridge round we were counting on from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct, even though the term sheet was basically ready. We couldn’t keep spending at the same rate after that.

Firing people was honestly the worst day of my life, and you all know how badly I took failing maths in 2nd sem. We gave everyone two months’ pay, and we’ve already helped four of them get interviews. Still hurts.

After the cuts, we have about five months of runway. The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbers and electricians are growing, but AC servicing is bleeding money, so we’re shutting that part down and focusing on housing society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have already signed up for pilots.

I genuinely think the societies are a real shot for us, but they’re pilots, not a guarantee. So the honest answer for you and Divya is: **your 3 lakh is at risk, but it isn’t gone.** You came in on the same terms as everyone else in the 2025 friends round. I can’t promise you’ll get it back, and I don’t want to pretend I know how this ends.

Can we get on a call, both of you and me, sometime this week? I’ll show you the numbers properly and answer whatever you want to ask. Divya shouldn’t have to get her investment updates through this group’s panel of financial experts.

For the record, the VC partner told us “we love the energy” and then vanished for 11 days. Apparently energy doesn’t pay salaries. Meanwhile I’ve eaten Maggi at the office at 11 pm so often that the security uncle now asks me “masala or plain?” like I’m a regular at a five-star restaurant.

Amma asked me last week if TCS is still hiring, so the family board has also weighed in.

I’m okay, guys. It’s been a rough stretch, but I’m coming Saturday. Pranav is buying, obviously. Consider it a bridge round 🍻
